summary: Stage-3 full-stack test of SeekProfit. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_stage3.py (14 cases) covering GET /api/signals/members (owner+invited roles), owner_email/due_date/sla_status on the signals list, POST /api/signals/{id}/assign (auto SLA 3/7/14d per urgency verified to <0.5d tolerance, open->in_progress, explicit ISO due_date honored, unassign clears due_date + reopens, 404 on unknown id), ?status=in_progress and ?owner=me filters, GET /api/reports/executive (workspace/headline/3 category_totals/8 trend buckets/<=8 top_actions/top_counterparties/resolved_wins + pipeline-vs-category cross-check + 401 unauth), and the SSE stream GET /api/ai/ask/stream (text/event-stream, event: open first, 3+ delta events, done with corrected text + resolved citations, unresolved [rec:] tokens stripped, 401 on token=deadbeef, 422/401 with no token). 14/14 pass. Iteration-2 regression suite re-run: 31/31 pass (AI enrich long-running class skipped). Frontend: verified Action Center (queue 14 rows, all 4 tabs + stat strip updating, assign via dropdown -> owner + 'Aug 30' due + 'On track · 3d' SLA badge, signal correctly moves into In progress / Assigned to me, unassign, resolve removes from Queue and appears in Resolved, row expand), Reports (all sections, 3 category cards, 8 action rows, Recharts chart, Refresh re-fetches /api/reports/executive, Print/Save PDF visible+enabled), AI streaming (Ask button 'Thinking…', 'STREAMING…' pill next to SEEKPROFIT ANALYST, progressive answer growth observed across 12+ distinct partial lengths, pulse cursor clears on done, citation chips all record-prefixed with zero dead anchors, cited-records list populated), regression on all 9 /app routes, and sign-out clearing localStorage + protected-route redirect. 2 real defects found (React key console error on Action Center, mobile horizontal overflow on Action Center) plus a security review note on the JWT-in-query-string SSE auth.

minor.issue: Sorting is applied AFTER the Mongo fetch (`to_list(limit)` then Python sort). With more signals than `limit` the returned page is an arbitrary Mongo subset, so 'Ordered by Impact x Confidence x Urgency' is only true within that subset. Push the sort into the query (`.sort('priority_score', -1)`).

`_category_totals` is built from a defaultdict over existing signals, so a workspace missing a category returns fewer than 3 entries and the 'By category' row silently shrinks. Seed all three categories with zeros for a stable board layout.
Loads up to 5000 records + 500 signals and recomputes KPIs/trend on every call with no cache; Refresh on the UI re-triggers the full scan.

JWT is passed in the query string (`?token=`). The client uses fetch (not EventSource), so it CAN send an Authorization header — the token is currently exposed in ingress access logs / browser history. Accept the header and treat ?token= as fallback only.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error on every render: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — the row map returns a bare <> fragment with the key placed on the inner <tr> instead of the fragment. Use <Fragment key={s.signal_id}>.

Whole document scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth 452 vs clientWidth 390). The SectionCard header actions (Queue / In progress / Assigned to me / Resolved TabsList) do not wrap, pushing past the card; 'Resolved' tab is cut off and the 'Signal queue' title squeezes to 3 lines. Reports page has no overflow (390/390).

issues: Assigning a signal from the Queue tab makes the row vanish immediately (status becomes in_progress, which the Queue filter excludes). Functionally correct but jarring — a toast alone; consider keeping the row briefly or noting 'moved to In progress'.
Recharts Y-axis tick labels are clipped on the left at 1920px ('100k' renders as 'I00k', '$50k' as "'50k"); increase the YAxis width / left margin.

action_items: ActionCenterPage: key the fragment (Fragment key={s.signal_id}) to clear the React key console error.
ActionCenterPage mobile: let the tab strip wrap/scroll inside the card so the page does not overflow horizontally at 390px.
Push signal ordering into the Mongo query instead of sorting the truncated page in Python.
Return all three category buckets (zero-filled) from /api/reports/executive.
Accept the Bearer header on /api/ai/ask/stream and stop putting the JWT in the URL query string.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/reports.py duplicates the same `_workspace()` lookup already copy-pasted in signals.py, ai.py, imports.py, overview.py, onboarding.py — this is now 6 copies; extract a single FastAPI dependency (core/deps.py get_workspace).
_top_counterparties() is annotated `-> List[dict]` but returns a dict of two lists — the type hint is wrong and misleading.

lib/aiStream.js never fires a callback if the reader ends without a `done`/`error` event (e.g. ingress drops the connection); the UI would stay stuck on 'Thinking…'. Emit onError when the loop exits without a terminal event, and add a timeout.
routers/ai.py still imports private symbols (_brief_for_ask, _chat, _collect, ASK_SYSTEM) from services.llm_analyst; promote a public service function.
constants/testIds.js still only registers PAGE ids — all the new action-*/report-* ids are hardcoded strings in the components.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Stage-3 flows working; 2 UI defects found

seed_data_creation: No new persistent data. Stage-3 pytest classes register throwaway @seekprofit-qa.com users with the demo dataset (assign/unassign exercised there). Demo workspace cfo@demo.seekprofit.app was mutated by the UI tests then fully restored via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_stage3.py — verified end state: 15 signals, all status=open, no owners.
test_credentials: cfo@demo.seekprofit.app / demo1234 (works; demo workspace restored). Login test ids are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button (NOT login-*). Sign-out: app-user-menu-trigger -> app-user-menu-logout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_stage3.py -v (SSE happy-path takes ~10s; pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, do not edit). Playwright gotchas learned this run: (1) auth test ids are auth-*, not login-*; (2) Playwright inner_text applies CSS text-transform, so section labels read as 'EXPLANATION'/'TOP ACTIONS' in uppercase — assert case-insensitively; (3) assigning a signal from the Queue tab removes the row from that tab (status -> in_progress), so verify owner/due/SLA on the 'Assigned to me' or 'In progress' tab; (4) always cleanup with tests/cleanup_stage3.py after UI assign/resolve tests. Still not covered: Google OAuth callback exchange, an invited user actually signing in and joining the owner workspace, the Overview 'Export brief'/'Last 8 months' buttons, and CSV-import + Action Center interaction.
rca_of_the_issue: ActionCenterPage key error: the row map returns `<>...</>` and puts key={s.signal_id} on the child <tr>, so the fragment (the actual array element) has no key. Mobile overflow: SectionCard's `actions` slot renders the 4-item TabsList inline with the title in a non-wrapping flex row, so at 390px the intrinsic width (~452px) exceeds the viewport and the document itself scrolls horizontally; the table's own overflow-x-auto does not help because the overflow comes from the card header.
